name: Chenvaala
guide_text: Try not to spend a lot of money leveling on this hero. You can buy elementals, and then level to taverns 5 or 6 when it's 3 or less gold.
buddy_guide_text: Buddy up when it costs 3-5 gold. [[Vine Climber]] is probably the best stabilization card with Elementals.
